mapper.select: SELECT s.*, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credit, u.real_name as studentName, u.student_no as studentNo FROM score s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN user u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM score WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT s.*, c.course_name, c.course_code, c.credit FROM score s LEFT JOIN course c ON s.course_id = c.id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
SELECT s.*, u.real_name as studentName, u.student_no as studentNo FROM score s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.student_id = u.id WHERE s.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY s.total_score DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO score (course_id, student_id, usual_score, midterm_score, final_score, total_score, grade_level, gpa) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{studentId}, #{usualScore}, #{midtermScore}, #{finalScore}, #{totalScore}, #{gradeLevel}, #{gpa})
